extra.reason: Added flutter_contacts ^1.1.9+2 dependency, NSContactsUsageDescription to ios/Info.plist, ContactImportService abstract interface + FlutterContactImportService concrete impl, ImportableContact value model, ContactPermissionStatus enum, contactImportServiceProvider Riverpod provider. 8 unit tests covering model + provider; concrete OS-boundary impl follows haptic_service pattern (untested at unit level).

ContactImporter service with field mapping (name, phone[0], email[0], birthday, jobTitle, thumbnail), duplicate detection (phone OR email match, name fallback), skip/update strategies, optional circle assignment, AvatarStore abstraction with FilesAvatarStore impl using path_provider, ImportConfig + ImportResult value types. 13 unit tests cover all behaviors. Note: per-contact ops are not yet wrapped in a transaction (orphans possible if a step fails mid-import); imported contacts have is_dirty=true so future sync would reconcile.

ImportSourceScreen with iPhone Contacts / CSV / vCard tiles (latter two disabled as coming-soon). Permission request flow via injected ContactImportService. Loading indicator during async load. Denied-permission UI with placeholder 'Open Settings' action (deep-link wiring left for a follow-up — needs url_launcher with app-settings: scheme). Loaded contacts persisted to loadedImportContactsProvider for downstream selection screen. /import route added. 4 widget tests covering picker rendering, disabled tiles, granted-permission flow, denied-permission flow.

Added 'Data' section to SettingsScreen with 'Import Contacts' tile linking to /import. Extended NoContactsIllustration/EmptyStateIllustration with optional secondary action; ContactListScreen empty state now offers 'Import from your phone' as a secondary CTA alongside 'Add Your First Contact'. 2 new widget tests.

Delivered 4 distinct brand profiles in docs/brand/brand-profiles.md (Warm Companion, Calm Keeper, Gentle Coach, Living Garden), each with personality, voice/tone, visual feel, positioning, and in-voice touchpoints + comparison table for persona testing.

Round 2: kept Gentle Coach as anchor; added three new distinct territories (Orbit, Pulse, Thread), each with its own redesigned status indicator replacing the green/yellow/red health ring. Updated comparison table + persona-test notes. docs/brand/brand-profiles.md.
